label: Retail & e-commerce advertising
description: Layered on top of the generic set. Pricing accuracy and delivery promises are the primary exposure in retail advertising.

rules.title: Reference pricing without a qualifying period
rules.reason: "Was/now" pricing requires the higher price to have been genuinely charged for a qualifying period. State it or drop the comparison.

rules.title: Absolute delivery promises
rules.reason: Delivery claims must be consistently achievable. Absolute wording invites complaints on the exceptions.

rules.title: Free shipping with unstated conditions
rules.reason: If free delivery has a spend threshold, the ad should say so.

rules.title: Stock scarcity claims
rules.reason: Scarcity claims must reflect real stock levels.
